say:1:1630811001:0.text: See that girl? Always reading by the window. Never picks another seat.
say:1:1630811001:0.source_cn: 那个女生……她总是爱在窗前那个位置读书。
say:1:1630811001:0.male: See that girl? Always reading by the window. Never picks another seat.
say:1:1630811001:0.female: See that girl? Always reading by the window. Never picks another seat.

say:2:1630811002:1.text: I know the spot. Warm in winter, cool in summer. I used to sit there too... when I was still around—physically, I mean.
say:2:1630811002:1.source_cn: 我知道，那个位置冬暖夏凉，我生前也爱待在那里。
say:2:1630811002:1.male: I know the spot. Warm in winter, cool in summer. I used to sit there too... when I was still around—physically, I mean.
say:2:1630811002:1.female: I know the spot. Warm in winter, cool in summer. I used to sit there too... when I was still around—physically, I mean.

say:3:1630811003:1.text: And look—A Brief History of Magic. My favorite. She even holds it the same way I used to.
say:3:1630811003:1.source_cn: 她也爱读《魔法简史》呢……那是我生前最爱的书。
say:3:1630811003:1.male: And look—A Brief History of Magic. My favorite. She even holds it the same way I used to.
say:3:1630811003:1.female: And look—A Brief History of Magic. My favorite. She even holds it the same way I used to.

say:4:1630811004:1.text: If you look closer... she kind of looks like me, doesn't she?
say:4:1630811004:1.source_cn: 仔细一瞧，她长得跟生前的我也有点儿像……
say:4:1630811004:1.male: If you look closer... she kind of looks like me, doesn't she?
say:4:1630811004:1.female: If you look closer... she kind of looks like me, doesn't she?
